raw_segments.text: Yes, yes, you are right," said he.
I have plenty of faults of my own.
I know it, and I don't wish to palliate them, I assure you.
God what, I need not be too severe about others.
I have a past existence, a series of deeds, a color of life to contemplate within my own
breast, which might well call my sneers and censures from my neighbors to myself.
I started, or rather, for like other defaulters, I liked to lay half the blame on ill, fortune
and adverse circumstances, was thrust on to a wrong tack at the age of one in twenty,
and have never recovered the right course since.
But I might have been very different.
I might have been as good as you, wiser, almost as stainless.
I envy you your peace of mind, your clean conscience, your unpolluted memory.
